notes.title: SCP: Event Classified v0.5.3
notes.content:
Hello, we have delivered this new patch for the game, below you can find a list of the main changes.
Meanwhile we are preparing more things for you, so stay tuned.
Thanks for your support and have a nice day. =)

Client fixes:
- Fix door and light unloading behavior that was causing missed doors and strange door animator behavior (doors opening when you look at them)
- Fix voice chat bug in idle voice mode
- Fix short player ID bug for a console
- Fix bug with grabbing "Q" items
- Fix official server list population (some players got timed out from time to time and didn't see official servers)
- Fix bug when closing a server list window before receiving official servers
- Fixed bug with weapon fire and crosshairs when exiting the game or switching to spectator mode
- Fixed map softlocks that happened from time to time
- Added handler for players who fell under the map, now teleporting them to their nearest spawn point
- Added a slider for an item to prevent players from jumping on it and glitching through the map

Server fixes:
- Fixed non-working custom ports in a server config

Features:
- Camera shake when walking and running has been reduced twice and now depends on the weight you are carrying in your inventory
- Spectator camera now teleports instantly between players and has smooth obstacle avoidance to prevent rare clipping
- New flashbang and explosion sounds added
- Human player breathing now twice as quiet as before
- Updated localizations

Art:
- SCP 303 model created, along with all relevant bones and rigging
- Added a new variation of containment_tunnel_third
- Created new texture iterations for keycards
- Cultist worm created with rig and textures

Tech:
- Removed unused Zenject plugin
- Updated FMOD to v2.02.21
- Update mirror to v89.0.0

notes.title: YOU **MISSED** THE NEW SCP OBJECT!
notes.content:
**Meet definitely not SCP-173**

What can it do?

1. When you're not looking - he's coming. And as it approaches, its huge legs are reaching straight for you.  After changing location, his posture will change.

2. You **blink** - he's getting closer. Oh yeah, now you can **blink**! And not just because of the SCP-173. There is a separate button to "close your eyes" for long periods of time to escape SCP-689 and even **[DATA EXPUNGED]**.

3. The SCP-173 can break necks in the **BLINK** of an eye as well as **DOORS!** Yes! Doors can now be broken!

4. SCP-173 has a unique ability that makes everyone around him go blind. 

5. It is so big and cool that it will block any passageway, as well as terrify you as soon as you **SEE** it (Has its own unique audio effects and ambience).

6. **MOVABLE LEGS (?HANDS?)**! Yes, after changing pose, the statue changes the position of its legs. The same kinematics mechanism we will use for SCP-363 **(don't forget to delete the mention of SCP-363, agent, it's secret information)**

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE IS APRIL 26TH (And a lot of videos)
notes.content:
Yeah, we've been aiming for this for 6 years. It's time to really come out of the basement! 
And it's only thanks to YOU, who have already given us 32,000 wishlists!

As a reminder, the game will cost $10, but we will offer the lowest regional prices (around $6 in CIS regions).

Now we are polishing and fixing the latest bugs, but we can also please with fresh features (LIKE VIDEOS):

1. EXPLOSIONS! All types: wall-mounted, remote, and even just a claymore on the floor. In order:
- Wall-mounted is analogous to a tripwire. If you walk past it, you're dead.
- Remote explosives require a DETONATOR. WHERE'S THE DETONATOR? Somewhere on the map, it could be anything that broadcasts radio frequencies.
- The claymore works like a claymore. (it hurts)

https://youtu.be/0H0DBD78EQc

- Open locked doors remotely.
- A DOOR LOCK! It can be placed on the keypad of a door, and it will keep it closed until it is removed.
- Solve some mini quests.
- Build traps (e.g., blow up C4 if a person opens a door with a component).

https://youtu.be/VV8inNTl38Q

https://youtu.be/dv-FZweYW0k

https://youtu.be/TgCTrQD8LxY
https://youtu.be/Tryx9pCwfzo

5. SARKYCIST! Specifically, under the auspices of The Serpent's Hand. What is he doing? Where did it come from? And it's simple - ██████████████████████████████████████

This will add depth to gameplay for those players who want to BUILD COWARDLY PLANS and ambush other people. Or maybe not just people...

notes.title: Recent updates (RESPAWNS! BRAIN IMPLANTS! What?)
notes.content:
First of all, we want to implement more features and fix some bugs, so the public playtest has been postponed for a month.

But what are the big features? If you don't want to miss it, make sure to subscribe to our Steam Community - https://steamcommunity.com/app/1955030 , there are posts in many languages, special thanks to our translators!

And no, this is not a recommendation. SUBSCRIBE NOW https://steamcommunity.com/app/1955030 , it will be easier for us.

So, a lot of interesting changes have been made:

1. The most important update is the RESPAWN SYSTEM!
Now dead players have a chance to be reborn into a support soldier during an ongoing game session. But not only soldiers...
We will tell you the detailed mechanics in a separate post.

2. The next feature is Brain Implants. What? Implants? Yes, implants. No, we're not in cyberpunk, it's just that the support soldiers will have them in their heads.
The first of the implants is the MICROBOMB. You can see it in your inventory, and it has the following benefits:
- Your head can be remotely detonated. Pretty cool, right?
- [DATA EXPUNGED]

In addition to this, there is also a slot for the SENSOR. The Sensor allows you to see the health of players who have the same SENSOR. This way, the support soldiers can distinguish others from their own and take care of each other like a real family (not).

Only support soldiers will have them, they will not spawn at the beginning of the game. Normal soldiers and security service will not have such implants.

3. STEAM SERVICE INTEGRATION! Now you will see the avatar and username of players from their STEAM account. Goodbye Player_0 Player_1 and Player_undefined

4. SOUNDS! They now have a radius. Yes, you can now hear the footsteps of other players.

5. The most long-awaited: we fixed the back of players. Now you can look under your feet, those who were in the playtest will understand

6. The game now supports custom servers, which are created by the players themselves, and displays them in the list of servers with the others.

notes.title: Price Update and Launch Date
notes.content:
After the Games Gathering Conference and latest updates, we have decided to change our price policy. This will not affect our playtests before early access! They will still be free-to-play until EA is released. After early access launch at the end of this year, the game will cost $4.99.

Here's why:

- First of all, we're getting bigger than we expected. The project that was planned as an indie experiment is growing to be something unique in a big scale.

- Hiring volunteers is very risky. A few months ago, one of the “volunteer” coders simply stole the assets and blocked us :/. We don't know what he can do with it, because all assets are protected by Steam, but the situation is a little bit sad anyway, so we must be more careful and hire experienced and trustworthy people for money.

- Publishers and investors are only interested in premium/paid games. Free games are risky and it's hard to explain how we can “get money” with a free game through monetization, and we don't want to bring any form of “pay to win”.

- Lastly, anti cheat and cheaters. In a free game, that can easily go out of control, so a price wall can cover that and prevent “multi-accounts” and the likes.

In-game monetization is definitely harder to develop than simply having a Steam price. We know that some of you will be worried about it, but the price will be and will stay small. We'll cost like two cups of coffee. Before launch, we will publish a full gameplay trailer, with all mechanics, roles and features, to let YOU decide if we are worth buying.

Our Steam page will transform completely, because NOW we are REALLY ready to show something. Thank you all! Don't miss our playtest with new voice chat. Playtesting will be happening regularly until our early access launch. 

Also, we will attend Steam's Ukrainian Game Festival! Find us in the horror section :3

notes.title: LATEST NEWS AND PLAYTEST RESULTS
notes.content:
LATEST NEWS AND PLAYTEST RESULTS:

Thank you all!
We received a lot of feedback and found a lot of bugs.
As we said before, this was just a test, and such tests will continue.

The cycle will be simple: we'll make some bug fixes , add some new content and mechanics and then reopen the test for a couple of days. After that we'll get feedback and then work again until next test date.
After a certain number of cycles, the real early access will come out.

And now, about the important innovations after the first test:

- The inventory will be completely redesigned. Old idea is interesting, but the new concept will be much more convenient, clearer, and won't break the game as much.

- MORE ICONS! For every type of clothing.

- Slight rebalance of damage and bleed chance throughout the game. We've noticed various oddities, and we'll fix them

- More propping variations.

- And finally, VOICE CHAT. We will try to integrate it for the next test.
ROBOTS. VACUUM. CLEANERS. WE (DO NOT) HOPE.

notes.title: MAP CHANGES
notes.content:
- Big upgrade of the procedural map generator. Now it can stitch together different large zones (as in the example below, Office and Cargo), which gives us a giant map from different zones.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/adfe542147ccd53570b2d6e0434d5197299e9610.png

- Large zones will be connected in a separate large room with elevators - a transitional place, since different parts of the zone are at different heights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/426348beba5fc75cba163025b93a8e0d77046431.png

- Also now the generator seamlessly connects rooms, which makes it possible to make LOOOOONG corridors that are not separated by doors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/c36e9de0f1d6157534e21abe5d7f32ac45df2331.png

- Reworked light on locations. This is also a mini-teaser of the new mechanics related to light. Players will be able to [DATA EXPUNGED] in [DATA EXPUNGED].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/96ad0d0d2276141b96e504f452b0031389673eaf.png

- ROBOT.  VACUUM. Robot vacuum cleaners are not only cute, but also [DATA EXPUNGED]. Their function is normal except for [DATA EXPUNGED]. And there will also be a special [DATA EXPUNGED].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/510418e5cc31ddec0a8f2ea36a2591034b5a5c17.png

- Optimizations, more optimizations. The map has become larger, and the lags are only smaller.
- We are working on a landing page so that you better understand what we are ^^^

notes.title: Summer updates
notes.content:
- Perks. The system is completely ready and can be accessed via the player's inventory.
There are 16 of perks in total. Half of them are positive effects, the other half - negative. At the beginning of the game, each player receives 2 positive and 2 negative perks that do not conflict with each other.
Thus, each player will be unique, having their individual strengths and weaknesses.
In the future, there will be more perks, and their effects will be even more diversified.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/6d1c65a2f550e892f4d06d3facfde4f630276374.png

- New weapon! P90. Comes with a Holo-Sight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/ae16df778fff360eba14f0a991779bc1688581e9.png

- New “transition” zones in between the different major locations on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294352/e461e0b4b59375b583bac399fd2ab5bb4932e551.png

- A cosmetic customization system is in the works. The player will be able to scavenge gear from other players to disguise and mislead (pants, helmet, body armor, outerwear).
